description.content:
Security-oriented API test collection for the DigiBank DAST campaign (Workshop 3).

Covers:
  - Happy-path smoke for customers, accounts, transactions and compliance
  - Input validation boundaries (negative/zero amounts, empty fields, invalid email)
  - Error response shape (checks that no stack trace / class names leak)
  - Security header assertions (X-Content-Type-Options, etc.)
  - Not-found / 404 response envelope quality (incl. compliance)
  - Generic-error assertions (no raw ids echoed from 404/invalid responses)

Environments (same key set, different baseUrl):
  - DigiBank-local.postman_environment.json  (http://127.0.0.1:8080)
  - DigiBank-dev.postman_environment.json    (https://dev.digibank.internal)
  - DigiBank-prod.postman_environment.json   (https://api.digibank.example)

Run with Newman (see dast/postman/newman-run.sh):
  npx newman run DigiBank-DAST-Validation.postman_collection.json \
    --environment DigiBank-local.postman_environment.json \
    --reporters cli,json,html
